$comment: Source of truth for event routing: one Pub/Sub topic per type, one push subscription per consumer (POST /events/{type}), one BigQuery subscription per topic. Read by libs/platform-py, infra/tofu and the local relay.

events.description: A citizen report was confirmed by the reporter and stored with hashed evidence, with optional reporter-defined custom text fields separate from domain rule inputs.
A public signal (news, official release, shared social post) was extracted into a structured incident.
A case was opened or its status, evidence deadline or linked reports changed.
An audit finding is ready for human validation.
Validation of a finding reached quorum (approved) or was rejected.
An organization (newsroom or agency) proved control of its domain.
A validator was activated with a role, field, region and tier.
An audit report was generated from a validated finding.
An audit report was delivered to a subscribed institution's webhook.
An institution updated the follow-up status of a case through the institution API.
An institution submitted a right of reply for a case.
A decision (agent step, rule result or human action) to append to the public hash-chained log. Any service may publish it; only transparency writes the log.
District boundaries (public reference data) were loaded or changed; transparency projects them for the public map.
